ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word مَطْبَخٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ghurfa
   B. milʿaqa
   C. matbakh
   D. sikkiin

2. What does the Arabic sentence جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. My grandmother loves me.

3. Which Arabic word means "father's brother"? (1 mark)
   A. جَدَّةٌ
   B. عَمٌّ
   C. جَدٌّ
   D. خَالَةٌ

4. Which Arabic word means "dance"? (1 mark)
   A. رَقْصٌ
   B. كَعْكَةٌ
   C. حَفْلَةٌ
   D. هَدِيَّةٌ

5. What does the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. shoulder
   B. close the door
   C. hand
   D. new

6. In which direction is Arabic written? (1 mark)
   A. From left to right
   B. From right to left
   C. From the middle outwards
   D. From top to bottom only

7. What is the name of the Arabic letter ي? (1 mark)
   A. zaay
   B. yaa
   C. Saad
   D. waaw

8. Which is a good way to take care of the environment? (1 mark)
   A. Throw rubbish in the river
   B. Burn plastic in the open
   C. Cut trees without planting new ones
   D. Plant trees and keep the surroundings clean

9. Which Arabic word means "salt"? (1 mark)
   A. مِلْحٌ
   B. بَطَاطِسُ
   C. مَاءٌ
   D. تُفَّاحٌ

10. Which Arabic sentence means "I am a pupil (boy)." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ
   B. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   C. أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ
   D. اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ

11. Which Arabic sentence means "Water is useful (good for you)." (1 mark)
   A. أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ
   B. الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ
   C. السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ
   D. الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ

12. How is the Arabic word قَلَمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. qalam
   B. sahn
   C. taawila
   D. kuub

13. How is the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. usbuuʿ
   B. al-ithnayn
   C. amsi
   D. as-sabt

14. What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The house is big.
   B. On the table there is a cup.
   C. In the kitchen there is a table.
   D. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

15. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my house." (1 mark)
   A. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   B. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ
   C. هَذَا بَيْتِي
   D. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why it is important to know the days of the week. (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Give three points you would check when you assess a friend's reading. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Write four foods or drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

19. Translate into English: al-jawwu baarid (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

21. Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — matbakh
   مَطْبَخٌ is read matbakh and means kitchen.

2. D — My grandmother loves me.
   جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي (jaddatii tuhibbunii) means: My grandmother loves me.

3. B — عَمٌّ
   عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

4. A — رَقْصٌ
   رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

5. D — new
   جَدِيدٌ (jadiid) means new.

6. B — From right to left
   Arabic is written from right to left.

7. B — yaa
   The letter ي is called yaa.

8. D — Plant trees and keep the surroundings clean
   Planting trees and keeping the area clean protect the environment.

9. A — مِلْحٌ
   مِلْحٌ (milh) means salt.

10. A — أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ
   أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

11. D — الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ
   الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

12. A — qalam
   قَلَمٌ is read qalam and means pen.

13. A — usbuuʿ
   أُسْبُوعٌ is read usbuuʿ and means week.

14. B — On the table there is a cup.
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

15. C — هَذَا بَيْتِي
   هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Days help us to plan what to do and to use time well, for example school, homework and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for planning and 1 mark for good use of time.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words pronounced correctly; smooth reading without stops; heavy and throat sounds clear; no word skipped.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.
